__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="magic-dpm-advice" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Magic DPM Advice</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel will go over general damage output lessons, ability prioritisation, a learning path, and style-specific solutions for common PvM concerns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Knowledge of in-game ability/item descriptions is assumed, this guide aims to tie the tools together rather than list what they do</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For general PvM terminology, damage tips, and revolution bars, check out their respective sections in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To compare abilities, use </nowiki>[https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/magic <nowiki>RS Analysis' Magic Page</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and add your gear</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="core-magic-rotation"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Core Magic Rotation</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This section covers rotations using core style abilities before later unlocks are obtained</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>See </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Advanced Magic Rotations</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section further down for info on magic rotations using best-in-slot gear</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>A typical Magic rotation uses the strongest Basic Abilities available to build adrenaline, and spends it on the strongest available Enhanced Abilities, Ultimate Abilities, or Special Attacks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While doing this, we must think about the following </nowiki><strong><nowiki>key considerations:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Basic ability patterns </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Buff usage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spell effects </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="basic-pattern"><ins><nowiki>Basic Pattern</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>If Greater Concentrated Blast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not unlocked, use the regular version </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1087373968731811880.png?v=1" alt="conc" title="conc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Greater Concentrated Blast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should form the foundation of your rotation</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Try to follow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with strong abilities that can critically strike </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The basic pattern uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> often in blocks of 3 abilities</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>[</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → Ability → Ability </nowiki><strong><nowiki>]</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → Repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When building adrenaline, fill the empty slots with strong Basic Abilities:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon Breath </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sonic Wave </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063115709972651.png?v=1" alt="sonic" title="sonic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Combust </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Then spend adrenaline on Enhanced Abilites, Ultimate Abilities, and Special Attacks:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Such abilities are often categorically referred to as </nowiki><strong><nowiki>spenders</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Omnipower </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wild Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Lasts long enough to fill both empty slots between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> uses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This pattern helps ensure that your cooldowns are always cycling to allow for a consistent flow of strong abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sunshine"><ins><nowiki>Sunshine</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>It is assumed that either the Planted Feet perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Greater Sunshine unlock has been obtained </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the purposes of this guide</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sunshine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the main buff to prioritise whenever there is an opportunity to deal damage</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The exception to this is when the fight would end too quickly, or mechanics occur, and you can't benefit from the full duration</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, enter boss fights and important phases with 100% adrenaline so you can activate it immediately</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Sunshine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, continue following the basic pattern while fitting in your most powerful spenders:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Omnipower </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Wild Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎● Asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Keep in mind that Damage-over-Time (DoT) abilities such as Combust </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are not affected by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and most other damage buffs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While waiting for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown, you do not want to needlessly camp 100% adrenaline, and can start building when </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is nearly ready to use again</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="other-buffs"><ins><nowiki>Other Buffs</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Besides Sunshine, Magic has multiple buffing abilities that are meant to supplement and enhance its core rotation</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tsunami</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> grants adrenaline per critical strike and is most often used alongside </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Synergises with abilities that have built-in critical strike chance boosts </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sonic Wave</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1" alt="gsonic" title="gsonic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is typically used to save adrenaline while setting up </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can also be used on spenders </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to help maintain high adrenaline while waiting on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Runic Charge</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can flexibly enhance different basic abilities but is most commonly used for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (1) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1" alt="gsonic" title="gsonic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to allow for more immediate adrenaline during the buff window</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (2) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on either </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for consistent critical strikes on your highest damaging abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Asphyxiate</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> provides a critical strike damage boost after its full channel, often stacked with other buffs to maximise burst damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="spell-effects"><ins><nowiki>Spell Effects</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Magic spells can be clicked in the spellbook or right-clicked on an ability bar to be set to autocast, which 'selects' them to use with your abilities, like picking your ammo for a ranged weapon</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>When using abilities, stronger autocast spells can increase your ability damage and provide additional effects</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Autocast either Exsanguinate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or alternatively Incite Fear </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if you plan to use Tsunami </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Otherwise, use the highest rank of blood </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / air </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543465115870035999.png?v=1" alt="airsurge" title="airsurge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spell available or Crumble Undead </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1351696446646390824.png?v=1" alt="crumbleundead" title="crumbleundead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if applicable</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Any damaging spell can be dragged onto a hotbar slot to act as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1" alt="magicbasic" title="magicbasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> although you will gain the secondary effect of that spell when used rather than the secondary effect of your autocast</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is recommended to do so to maintain a consistent hit timing for your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1" alt="magicbasic" title="magicbasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, as certain spells such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit slower than others</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This guide will use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063104146411713.png?v=1" alt="magicbasic" title="magicbasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to denote basic attacks, although typically </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/914077639784935424.png?v=1" alt="emeraldaurora" title="emeraldaurora" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/574292444791963659.png?v=1" alt="rubyaurora" title="rubyaurora" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are chosen for faster hit timing and useful effects</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Smoke Cloud </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be prioritised on bosses that last over a minute, especially once further critical strike boosts are unlocked</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotation-examples"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Rotation Examples</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These are only suggestions to work from, and will not necessarily be applicable at all bosses or situations. For boss-specific rotations, see their respective guides.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="starting-unlocks"><ins><nowiki>Starting Unlocks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ring of Vigour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or its passive effect after </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction <nowiki>Extinction quest</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Super Adrenaline or Enhanced Replenishment Potions </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/634350450887622656.png?v=1" alt="enhreplen" title="enhreplen" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Adrenaline potion rotations can be looped with the corresponding non-adrenaline potion rotation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Greater Sunshine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409577014599701.png?v=1" alt="gsunshinecodex" title="gsunshinecodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Planted Feet perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1" alt="pf" title="pf" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Greater Concentrated Blast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411706395635782.png?v=1" alt="gconccodex" title="gconccodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Greater Sonic Wave </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095411830207299654.png?v=1" alt="gsoniccodex" title="gsoniccodex" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Incite Fear </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Smoke Tendrils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in examples with Tsunami </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These rotations demonstrate the fundamental structure of magic's core rotation, and show typical ways of setting up the initial round of buffs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while sticking to the basic pattern. With further upgrades, this rotation can be progressively iterated upon even through endgame upgrades.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="pvm-decision-making"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>PvM Decision Making</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Next, we explore how magic solves common PvM scenarios and other style-specific decisions it has to make</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="area-of-effect-aoe"><ins><nowiki>Area-of-Effect (AoE)</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063105182269460.png?v=1" alt="chain" title="chain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / Greater Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the default option for dealing with AoE scenarios as magic</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Longer range AoE targeting than other options while being flexible in terms of adrenaline management</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use a powerful ability on the main target like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or high hitting special attacks such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If the main target dies before the followup ability is cast, the effect will be lost</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be used to briefly stun multiple targets with stun abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809655873556.png?v=1" alt="impact" title="impact" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Magma Tempest </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> deals high damage when targets are expected to survive for a longer period of time</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Targeted variant </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/924741973858996284.png?v=1" alt="magmatempesttarget" title="magmatempesttarget" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is good for setting up damage before enemies have spawned</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Is not classified as DoT damage, allowing it to benefit from Sunshine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and other damage buffs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can mostly finish ticking if used between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can also help with tagging and luring enemies into </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1" alt="magmatemptest" title="magmatemptest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 5x5 area</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Low Priority or Highly Situational</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Barrage Spells </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> provide a spammable AoE option but have restrictive 3x3 area and low damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Can be used for AoE healing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or freeze </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tsunami </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is usually only used for AoE when the timing lines up with when you would normally use it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragon Breath </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may be used for lower target counts (&lt;= 4) and can be boosted further with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption Blast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063113659093075.png?v=1" alt="corruptionblast" title="corruptionblast" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has higher multipliers than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> but is restrictive due to being classified as DoT and costing adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="spending-excess-adrenaline"><ins><nowiki>Spending Excess Adrenaline</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wild Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is your go-to spender and deals more damage than other options under most circumstances</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Essence of Finality Special Attacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are rarely needed for magic rotations due to the extremely low cooldown on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can automatically fill up to 2/3 of your rotation on their own</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Iban's Staff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1215929543068618752.png?v=1" alt="ibansstaff" title="ibansstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Legatus's Emberstaff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1451134746280329357.png?v=1" alt="legatusemberstaff" title="legatusemberstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used as the main </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> options</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For situations where you have adrenaline but no strong cooldowns available, or when fishing for high immediate burst damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guthix Staff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1" alt="gstaff" title="gstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used only when a hit chance boost is needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="dealing-with-movement"><ins><nowiki>Dealing with Movement</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Bosses may require you to move for mechanics during Sunshine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and/or mid-channel </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> occupies a 7x7 area, it is often possible to pre-position it to fit into any movement requirements a boss has</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise movement abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to quickly deal with mechanics and get back into </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> rather than running normally</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It's possible to input </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the same tick as the next ability to allow seamless repositions even after channels</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Simply tanking damage (with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed) is viable for expected and non-lethal amounts of damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For extremely movement intensive phases it may be ideal to not use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, in which case DoT such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may go up in priority</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="short-damage-checks"><ins><nowiki>Short Damage Checks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Some PvM scenarios emphasise short phases and quick damage checks rather than keeping up a consistent flow of damage</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In such cases, we have some of the following options:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shift </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timing to be used on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> precisely when required</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pre-</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> purely for the buff before these scenarios begin if time allows</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sources of damage that can be used ahead of time </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063454173532242.png?v=1" alt="magmatemptest" title="magmatemptest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can deal heavy damage while being completely adrenaline positive</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Utilising stalls and abilities with late hit timings </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to clip into the start of the next phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Equip a magic main-hand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + melee off-hand </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and click under yourself to make stalling at short range easier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Freely switch back to any magic weapon, then click the target to release the stall</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="reavers-ring-vs-channellers-ring"><ins><nowiki>Reaver's Ring vs Channeller's Ring</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>It may seem that Channeller's Ring pulls ahead due to the abundance of channelled abilities available to magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. However, the following should be considered:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellersring" title="channellersring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> does not boost some of magic's strongest abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Lightning Surge attacks during FSoA's special attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellersring" title="channellersring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has incredible synergy with Tumeken's Resplendence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 4-piece effect that buffs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Therefore, the general recommendation is Channeller's Ring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (4-piece+), and otherwise Reaver's Ring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when hit chance is not an issue</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, it is also possible to actively swap between both rings, using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellersring" title="channellersring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> otherwise</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="advanced-magic-rotations"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Advanced Magic Rotations</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This section focuses on tactics that make full use of endgame tools available to magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Players looking to optimise around Fractured Staff of Armadyl </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Tumeken's Resplendence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should use this section as reference.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sanctum-dual-wield-weapons"><ins><nowiki>Sanctum Dual Wield Weapons</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1" alt="odetodeceit" title="odetodeceit" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>These weapons generally become outclassed as a camp weapon once </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is obtained, skip ahead if past this point of gear progression</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Building </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1" alt="essencecorruption" title="essencecorruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is inefficient, but a single DoT use is required to keep stacks from expiring</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The best option for this is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> itself, since the first hit is not a DoT and is boosted by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using Combust </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immediately before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> allows us to refresh </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1" alt="essencecorruption" title="essencecorruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at around 10s remaining on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Conflagrate buff granted by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be held until </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends to make use of it without overlapping on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> duration</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Example:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" <nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Resets on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be optionally held until after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends to have a strong filler option while waiting for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> becomes a strong very strong ability while maintaining 10+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1" alt="essencecorruption" title="essencecorruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks, but better options are usually available during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Prebuilding with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833098100745.png?v=1" alt="comb" title="comb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the Wars dummies allows you to quickly build 30 stacks of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1" alt="essencecorruption" title="essencecorruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between boss kills</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="fractured-staff-of-armadyl"><ins><nowiki>Fractured Staff of Armadyl</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>An effective </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> rotation relies on landing critical strikes as often and reliably as possible</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Passive critical strike damage boost generally overtakes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418936820404295.png?v=1" alt="essencecorruption" title="essencecorruption" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at ~30%+ critical strike chance, making </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the primary camp weapon for endgame magic rotations</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1" alt="odetodeceit" title="odetodeceit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should still be kept for the special attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Where possible, you will overlap </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to get the most out of each effect</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Critical strike chance checklist:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Biting 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1" alt="biting4" title="biting4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Erethdor's Grimoire </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1" alt="grim" title="grim" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Either Reaver's Ring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943018283050.png?v=1" alt="reaverring" title="reaverring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Channeller's Ring </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Kal'gerion demon familiar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1" alt="kalgpouch" title="kalgpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with scrolls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1" alt="kalgscroll" title="kalgscroll" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tectonic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643849283199696917.png?v=1" alt="tectmask" title="tectmask" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Elite Tectonic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556582803014418432.png?v=1" alt="elitetectmask" title="elitetectmask" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, or Tumeken's Resplendance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> armour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eclipsed Soul </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1285372688457797672.png?v=1" alt="eclipsedsoul" title="eclipsedsoul" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ability priorities don't change much since much of magic's strongest abilities already synergise well with critical strikes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When running into adrenaline issues, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> guarantees at least 4 critical strikes and that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will be available immediately after</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 5-tick </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> helps to line up the next </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown perfectly, a useful trick for when </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is obtained</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Make sure to set your autocast to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if stacks were not maintained</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tumekens-resplendence"><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's Resplendence</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Although Tumekens </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is almost always better than running 3-piece Elite Tectonic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/552955120707698699.png?v=1" alt="elitetectbody" title="elitetectbody" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, there may be situations where very short-term critical strike burst requirements make the latter set slightly better</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This armour set is primarily used for its 4-piece and 5-piece effects that substantially buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We will prioritise pushing out </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as quickly as possible after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We have 9s of critical strike damage buff to work with now, changing our priorities for the next few abilities after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903943404027914.png?v=1" alt="channellerring" title="channellerring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can generate a massive amount of critical strikes under </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1279516151423963166.png?v=1" alt="critbuff" title="critbuff" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, making it another reliable source of adrenaline similar to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is now an excellent way to stack up </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> quickly. For example, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can fully stack up </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> near the start of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (loops)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We can now fit more abilities into each </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff, allowing us to aim for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + 2x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> under the buff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We actively utilise 5-tick </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to line up the second </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as early as possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Applicability of this can change from boss to boss</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We still have a slot to fill in with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but can be replaced with any other </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if doing group bosses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> itself becomes a solid damage ability while waiting for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="runic-charge-and-adrenaline-renewal"><ins><nowiki>Runic Charge and Adrenaline Renewal</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>In previous example rotations we have been using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1" alt="gsonic" title="gsonic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to guarantee more adrenaline after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This sacrifices a use on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> that we're unable to use on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during the first </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>In reality, there are multiple considerations that allow us to optimise our </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> uses</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be consistently skipped in the opener when </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is available</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Preparing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ~10s before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> allows it to be used on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1" alt="gsonic" title="gsonic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as usual while having it come up back up soon after the first </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In general, plan to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>as early as possible</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as long as it won't be consumed on the wrong ability</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This allows you to potentially find spots to squeeze in additional uses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Example (1 minute+):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="temporal-anomaly"><ins><nowiki>Temporal Anomaly</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1" alt="temporalanomaly" title="temporalanomaly" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Due to its random nature, Temporal Anomaly (TA) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1" alt="temporalanomaly" title="temporalanomaly" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is typically not written into rotations. However, using TA resets correctly can still result in improved kill times on average, even if the base rotation you work with is relatively static.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The value of most resets primarily comes down to the cooldown of the ability were you to use it again</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For example, a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reset is not particularly useful because it needs to be back up by the next </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (which cannot reset off TA), and casting it again runs the risk of de-syncing your major cooldowns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>TA reset considerations</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Best reset, allows additional casts during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> that isn't otherwise possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> With 4-piece </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400500746377625790.png?v=1" alt="tumekenrobetop" title="tumekenrobetop" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, can do the second cast earlier to get extra abilities under the buff near the end of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Deals good damage, can replace the next </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or filler ability if a reset occurs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Also allows additional casts under </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="fsoa" title="fsoa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> that isn't otherwise possible, though generally un-needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in AoE-heavy scenarios</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It's important to recognize that many TA resets will not be particularly useful in the context that they occur, don't feel obligated to use every one immediately. Often times, just prioritizing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> leads to the most </nowiki><strong><nowiki>consistent</nowiki></strong><nowiki> gains from TA, though fishing for more resets from abilities like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can lead to higher peaks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
